name: Colour Split
description: A picture whose red and blue channels peel apart and lean toward the pointer while the frame tilts, drawn with WebGL.

props.name: src
props.description: The image URL. Remote images need CORS headers to be drawn with WebGL; without them the plain image is shown.

props.name: shift
props.description: How far the red and blue channels separate, as a fraction of the image width. At rest only a trace of it remains, as fringing near the edges.

props.name: displacement
props.description: How far the picture slides toward the pointer, as a fraction of its size.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Scale of the picture while the pointer is over it.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Largest tilt of the frame on each axis, in degrees.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. Give it a size, for example an aspect ratio and a width, and a radius; the frame inherits the radius. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Overlay content, laid over the picture in a box of the same size and tilted with it.
